## Where I am

On branch `noa/rds-pg17`, the staging RDS module and environment are prepared for the PostgreSQL 16.4 to 17.2 blue/green upgrade. The AWS provider is pinned to 5.82, and the staging plan shows 1 to add and 1 to change. Nothing has been applied. Draft PR #57 is open. Prod is prepared but disabled. The pg_partman 5.x upgrade on staging is still a to-do, and no prod window has been chosen.

- [en-cours] Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 open; staging plan ready (1 add, 1 change), not applied
- [prochaine-étape] 1. Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 to 5.1.0 on staging (ALTER EXTENSION on 16.4), then check run_maintenance_proc() on events_raw and events_daily. 2. Get Maya's sign-off. 3. Pick a prod window outside the dbt lock.
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` without `-upgrade` failed on the lock file. `init -upgrade` pulled AWS v6, giving 37 changes, so it was reverted to the 5.82 pin. The first tflint run flagged an unused variable and a missing random provider constraint; both were fixed.
- [question] Prod window not chosen. The agent suggested Sat or Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC, avoiding the dbt lock on events_daily (01:00–03:30 UTC). Needs Maya's sign-off.
- [décision] Plan only, nothing applied (source: t01)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to ~> 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] pg_partman upgrade is a separate step, recorded as a to-do, nothing run against the DB (source: t10)
- [décision] Prod prepared but disabled, window must avoid the dbt lock (source: t12)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false (source: t14)
